note: Campground on the south shore of 99-acre Beeds Lake near Hampton, beside the CCC-built dam and spillway; grassy shaded loops with the tent sites along the shore, and a beach and the stone beach building nearby. --Claude
summary: Season year_round false -> true (RA: open and reservable year round; water off mid-Oct to ~May 1). Sites -> 134 (91 electric 50-amp, 2 full hookup, 40 tent, 1 youth), max 65 ft. Confirmed showers/flush toilets/dump, 100% reservable on ReserveAmerica, 3-month window. Fees left as recorded (DNR 2026 sheet). Pin ~230 m from the site centroid (42.76828,-93.23626; inside the limit). Lakeview confirmed: the official photo of site 71 shows the lake across open lawn and 73/74 show it through the trees; the campground's own loop road and the shoreline tent sites lie between the RV pads and the water, so not on-water. The campground sits beside the lake at pool level, not below the dam.
flags: Missing phone: the DNR park page gives 641-456-2047. apply.py doesn't write phone.
Full-hookup site H77's number suggests a host pad, though it is listed as reservable; the other full-hookup site (117) is a plain public site, so water/sewer stay true.

Note: the stored '~99 electric and 43 non-electric sites plus 2 full-hookup' and 'Open ~Apr 1-Oct 31' were wrong (91 electric, 40 tent-only, no non-electric RV sites; open year round), and the booking and park-fee lines repeated the fields. Cleaned.
